lead: Awkwafina has built a public profile as an American rapper, born on 2 June 1988 in Stony Brook.

She is associated with work such as Crazy Rich Asians, Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings and Raya and the Last Dragon and has been recognised with Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy and Libera Award for Best Hip-Hop/Rap Record.

sections.heading: Awkwafina — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Awkwafina was born on 2 June 1988 in Stony Brook, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Nora Lum at birth and is publicly known as Awkwafina.
She received her education at Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School, State University of New York at Albany and Beijing Language and Culture University.
She is recorded as speaking English.
